## Change Type

- [ ] Development PR: `feature/*`, `fix/*`, or `chore/*` into `dev`
- [ ] Promotion PR: `dev` into `main` after stable validation

## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance impact.

## Issue Closure

Use one line when this PR resolves an issue:

Closes #N

or:

Fixes #N

If no issue applies, write: `N/A`.

After merge, verify that each referenced issue is closed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests and checks passed
- [ ] Promotion PR: all required CI checks passed on `dev -> main`

## Merge

- [ ] The repository's automatic head-branch deletion setting remains enabled
